title: It detects Bitwig 5 fine
description: Just tested. It detects Bitwig 5 fine, but doesn't patch Beta 6 for me. I added manual path in the settings and it doesn't get saved after relaunch. So I only see Bitwig 5.3.13 in dropdowns under each theme. I'm on WIndows 10. It would also be cool to have some kind of "favorites" list or ability to pin themes
